description: Agent-based social adoption model on a homophilous small-world network with opinion dynamics (Friedkin-Johnsen), policy nudges, media influence, and habit/fatigue, designed to forecast daily adoption and related observables.

modules.name: NetworkBuilder
modules.description: Constructs the social network with homophily and community structure; initializes Person attributes.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if step == 0:
  set RNG with rng_seed
  assign community_id to each person ~ Categorical(community_count, equal)
  assign age_group, income_quantile per specified distributions
  build base ring lattice with population_size nodes and avg_degree
  for each edge: with probability rewiring_prob, rewire to random node
  adjust edge formation probabilities to increase within-community and similar age_group links using homophily_strength and assortativity_by_age
  add household cliques by sampling cluster sizes ~ Poissonish around household_cluster_size_mean
  initialize person attributes (opinion ~ Beta, etc.)
  set initial adopters by sampling initial_adoption_rate fraction; set adopted_day=0 for adopters
  output graph.G and population.persons
notes: Uses Watts-Strogatz small-world as base, modified by homophily reweighting.
Household cliques boost clustering and within-household contact probability.

modules.name: PolicyNudge
modules.description: Schedules and applies policy interventions (mandates, incentives, campaigns) and produces daily policy signals.

update_rule.pseudocode:
if day_index in [policy_start_day, policy_end_day]:
  policy_level = base_policy_level
  incentive = incentive_amount
  mandate = mandate
  enforcement = enforcement_prob
  campaign = information_campaign_intensity
else:
  policy_level = 0.0
  incentive = 0.0
  mandate = false
  enforcement = 0.0
  campaign = 0.0
broadcast signals.*
notes: Policy level is an aggregate of interventions and used as a scalar in adoption utility.
Can be extended to piecewise schedules via additional arrays.

modules.name: ContactGenerator
modules.description: Generates daily contact events along the network edges, with household and community bias.

update_rule.pseudocode:
contacts_today = []
for each person i:
  k = Poisson(contact_rate_per_day)
  candidate_neighbors = neighbors(i)
  weight neighbors by [household_bias if same household else 1.0] * [community_bias if same community else 1.0]
  sample min(k, deg(i)) unique neighbors without replacement by weights
  for each sampled neighbor j: append (i,j) to contacts_today
output contacts_today
notes: Symmetrize contacts by adding (j,i) if needed for exposure averaging.

modules.name: OpinionUpdater
modules.description: Updates individual opinions using a Friedkin-Johnsen process with peer and media exposures and memory decay.

update_rule.pseudocode:
for each person i:
  peer_opinion = mean(opinion[j] for (i,j) in contacts_today) if any else opinion[i]
  media_signal = signals.campaign_intensity * media_effectiveness
  combined_signal = person[i].peer_influence_weight * peer_opinion + person[i].media_influence_weight * media_signal
  noise = Normal(0, noise_std)
  o0 = person[i].opinion_initial
  oi = person[i].opinion
  oi_new = stubbornness_phi * o0 + (1 - stubbornness_phi) * ( (1 - memory_decay_lambda) * oi + memory_decay_lambda * (combined_signal + noise) )
  oi_new = clip(oi_new, 0, 1)
  rp_new = risk_perception_weight_opinion * oi_new + (1 - risk_perception_weight_opinion) * person[i].risk_perception
  set person[i].opinion = oi_new
  set person[i].risk_perception = clip(rp_new, 0, 1)
output updated opinions and risk perceptions
notes: FJ model anchors on initial opinion via stubbornness_phi.

modules.name: AdoptionDecision
modules.description: Chooses adoption based on utility from norms, risk perception, policy, incentives, fatigue, and habit persistence.

update_rule.pseudocode:
new_adoptions = 0
for each person i:
  peer_adoption_rate = mean(adoption[j] for (i,j) in contacts_today) if any else 0
  utility = baseline_utility
  utility += social_norm_weight * peer_adoption_rate
  utility += risk_perception_weight * person[i].risk_perception
  utility += policy_weight * signals.policy_level * person[i].policy_sensitivity
  utility += incentive_slope * signals.incentive_amount
  if signals.mandate_flag:
    utility += mandate_bonus * signals.enforcement_prob * person[i].compliance_propensity
  utility -= fatigue_penalty_weight * person[i].fatigue
  p_adopt = sigmoid(logistic_temp_beta * (utility - person[i].threshold))
  if not person[i].adoption:
    adopt_today = Bernoulli(p_adopt)
    if adopt_today:
      person[i].adoption = True
      person[i].adopted_day = current_day
      new_adoptions += 1
  else:
    # retention with habit persistence and fatigue
    retain_p = habit_persistence - fatigue_decay_on_retention * person[i].fatigue
    retain_p = clip(retain_p, 0, 1)
    stay = Bernoulli(retain_p)
    if not stay:
      person[i].adoption = False
  # update fatigue
  person[i].fatigue = max(0.0, person[i].fatigue + fatigue_increment_per_day - fatigue_recovery_per_day * (1 if not person[i].adoption else 0))
output adoption states and new_adoptions
notes: Utility-based threshold with logistic decision noise.
Mandates shift utility; enforcement interacts with compliance.

modules.name: ObservationAggregator
modules.description: Aggregates daily observables for comparison to data and downstream metrics.

update_rule.pseudocode:
N = population_size
adoption_rate = mean(person.adoption for person in persons)
new_adoptions_daily = state.new_adoptions_count
mean_opinion = mean(person.opinion for person in persons)
policy_level_daily = signals.policy_level
if smoothing_window_days > 1:
  apply trailing mean smoothing to above series
emit observables
notes: Observable smoothing optional; default window=1 (no smoothing).
Ensure correct alignment of day indices for metrics.

algorithms.graph_generation: Watts-Strogatz small-world with homophily reweighting and household cliques
algorithms.opinion_dynamics: Friedkin-Johnsen model with memory decay and media signal
algorithms.contact_sampling: Weighted sampling of neighbors with Poisson contact counts
algorithms.adoption_decision: Utility-threshold with logistic stochastic choice and habit persistence
